text: The concept of opportunity cost is related to the idea that?
options: Every good has a positive opportunity cost.
Every good has a negative opportunity cost.
Every good has an opportunity cost.
Opportunity cost is only related to production.
correctAnswer: Every good has an opportunity cost.
explanation: According to NCERT, opportunity cost is the value of the next best alternative foregone as a result of making a choice. It is related to every good.
subject: Economics

text: The production possibility curve (PPC) is a graphical representation of?
options: The maximum possible production of two goods.
The minimum possible production of two goods.
The actual production of two goods.
The potential production of two goods.
correctAnswer: The maximum possible production of two goods.
explanation: According to NCERT, the PPC is a graphical representation of the maximum possible production of two goods given the available resources.
subject: Economics

text: A positive statement in economics is one that?
options: Can be verified or falsified.
Cannot be verified or falsified.
Is a value judgment.
Is a fact.
explanation: According to NCERT, a positive statement in economics is one that can be verified or falsified, whereas a normative statement is a value judgment.
subject: Economics

text: The central problem of an economy is to?
options: Maximize the production of one good.
Maximize the production of two goods.
Allocate resources efficiently.
Minimize the production of two goods.
explanation: According to NCERT, the central problem of an economy is to allocate resources efficiently to produce goods and services.
subject: Economics

text: A shift of the PPC to the right indicates?
options: An increase in the production of one good.
A decrease in the production of one good.
An increase in the production of two goods.
A decrease in the production of two goods.
correctAnswer: An increase in the production of two goods.
explanation: According to NCERT, a shift of the PPC to the right indicates an increase in the production of two goods.
subject: Economics

text: The opportunity cost of producing one more unit of good X is?
options: The value of the next best alternative foregone.
The value of the last unit produced.
The value of the first unit produced.
The value of the average product.
correctAnswer: The value of the next best alternative foregone.
explanation: According to NCERT, the opportunity cost of producing one more unit of good X is the value of the next best alternative foregone.
subject: Economics

text: A normative statement in economics is one that?
options: Can be verified or falsified.
Cannot be verified or falsified.
Is a value judgment.
Is a fact.
explanation: According to NCERT, a normative statement in economics is one that is a value judgment.
subject: Economics

text: The PPC is a graphical representation of the?
options: Production possibilities frontier.
Production possibilities curve.
Production possibilities surface.
Production possibilities line.
explanation: According to NCERT, the PPC is a graphical representation of the production possibilities frontier.
subject: Economics

text: A decrease in the production of one good will lead to?
options: A shift of the PPC to the left.
A shift of the PPC to the right.
No change in the PPC.
A shift of the PPC upwards.
correctAnswer: A shift of the PPC to the left.
explanation: According to NCERT, a decrease in the production of one good will lead to a shift of the PPC to the left.
subject: Economics
